title: Noetherian koszul procomparison
statement: Let $A$ be a commutative Noetherian ring [def-weil-pbc-noetherian-ring], $a_1,\ldots,a_r\in A$ a finite list, and $I=(a_1,\ldots,a_r)$. Let $Q_m(A)=\bigotimes_{j=1}^r[A\xrightarrow{a_j^m}A]$ in degrees $[-r,0]$, with transition multiplication by $a_j$ in degree $-1$ and identity in degree $0$ in each factor. Here tensor products are total tensor products of ordinary $A$-module complexes: degree $q$ is the direct sum over tuples of degrees with sum $q$, and the differential has the usual sign $(-1)^{p_1+\cdots+p_{j-1}}$ on the differential of factor $j$. Equivalently, this is [def-pc-tensor-complex-sheaves] on the one-object site with only the identity covering and constant ring $A$. The degree-zero quotient maps define a strict morphism of towers $\epsilon_m:Q_m(A)\to A/I^m[0]$ of complexes of $A$-modules. In $D(A)$ [def-weil-abstract-derived-category], the tower of its mapping cones is pro-zero: for every $m\geq1$ there is $k\geq m$ such that the induced transition $\operatorname{Cone}(\epsilon_k)\to\operatorname{Cone}(\epsilon_m)$ is the zero morphism in $D(A)$. Mapping cones and their transition maps are those of the strict commutative squares of complexes.

source.place: Tag 0921 (lemma-sequence-Koszul-complexes), with the cofinal ideals (a_1^m,...,a_r^m) and I^m in the proof of Tag 0922 (proposition-noetherian-naive-completion-is-completion); zero cone transitions follow from Tags 0G3B/0G3C in derived.tex.

proof.text: Construct the degree-zero augmentation by the quotient map after exteriorPower.zeroEquiv: the existing private theorem ExteriorAlgebra.koszulBoundary_zero_quotient_formula from Sheaf.RingTheory.KoszulProjectiveResolution identifies the degree-one boundary with the linear combination of the generator powers, hence is killed by the quotient. Construct every transition as the exterior power of the diagonal with entries a_i^(k-m). The contraction formula boundary_wedge proves the chain-map identities, and zeroEquiv_naturality proves the strict augmentation square. Construct the quotient transitions by Submodule.factor. Check identity and composition of both families, then form the arrow tower and its strict homotopy-cofiber tower. These are explicit constructions and also apply to r=0.

Apply new-q2-koszul-power-homology-pro-zero to the specified diagonal transitions. Its proof uses contraction by a generator to show J_m times cycles lies in boundaries, then applies Artin-Rees inside the finite exterior-power term and bounds the diagonal image by a high power of J_m. This kills each positive homological degree eventually.

Apply new-q2-koszul-cone-homology-pro-zero to the actual augmentations, the strict squares, and the positive-homology vanishing from the preceding step. The helper proves the cone maps cohomologically zero using their explicit components: degrees below -1 reduce to positive Koszul homology; degree -1 follows from finite-generation cofinality of I^s and J_m; degree zero follows from the surjective augmentation; positive degrees have zero terms. Transfer this chain homology equality to derived homology using homologyFunctorFactors naturality.

The exterior-power basis is indexed by subsets of Fin r of the specified cardinality, so terms in degree n>r are zero, including when r=0. Extension to the integer cochain complex gives zero Koszul terms outside [-r,0]. The homotopy cofiber therefore has zero terms and zero cohomology outside [-r-1,0].

Apply lem-weil-pbc-bounded-derived-tower-pro-zero to the explicitly constructed strict cone tower, with bounds -r-1 and 0 and the cohomological vanishing from step 3. Its conclusion is exactly vanishing in D(A) of the cone transitions specified in the statement.
